what_they_do_well: Builds hampers from over a dozen major chocolate and biscuit brands, with city pages for Easter delivery.

companies.name: Beyond Best Before
companies.distributes: Snacks and treats including sweets, chocolate and biscuits from brands such as Haribo, M&M's, Oreo, Hi-Chew, Sour Patch Kids, Carman's and Orion, plus pantry, drinks and household goods
companies.channels_supplied: Own online snacks outlet and its store in Newtown, Sydney
companies.sf_brands_carried: Carman's bars
companies.fit_rationale: A Sydney discount snacks outlet that resells branded sweets, chocolate and biscuits online and in its Newtown store. It buys and holds stock of other brands, so Diablo's sweets and biscuits sit naturally in its snacks and treats range.
what_they_do_well: Runs a Newtown store open seven days alongside its online snacks outlet.

companies.name: Edible Blooms Pty Ltd (Gift Basket)

companies.fit_rationale: A national online gifting seller whose Gift Basket hampers are built from branded cookies and chocolate packed as they are. Diablo's gift boxes and chocolate boxes suit its sweet gift range; head office is not stated on the pages checked.
what_they_do_well: Offers same-day hamper delivery in Brisbane, Sydney, Melbourne, Perth and Adelaide.

companies.name: Treat Crate
companies.distributes: International snack subscription boxes and instant crates of snacks and sweets from a different country each month, plus individual snacks
companies.channels_supplied: Own online shop and monthly subscriptions, Australia-wide delivery
companies.fit_rationale: An Australian-owned snack subscription seller that buys foreign snacks and sweets and ships them to shoppers each month. A European month suits Diablo's sweets and biscuits; it is tier 3 because its website names no brands or head office.

companies.name: Byron Bay Gifts
companies.distributes: Chocolate gift hampers with cookies, pretzels, shortbread, chocolate macadamias, brownies, rocky road and chocolate bars from Byron Bay Cookies, Wallaby, Butterfingers, Duck Creek and Byron Bay Cacao
companies.channels_supplied: Own online shop with Australia-wide delivery
companies.fit_rationale: A hamper seller that fills its chocolate hampers with packed cookies, bars and chocolate from other producers. It is tier 3 because it is small and focuses on Byron Bay producers; head office address is not stated.
what_they_do_well: Builds hampers from local Byron Bay producers such as Byron Bay Cookies and Duck Creek Macadamias.

companies.name: The Hamper Boutique Co

companies.channels_supplied: Own online shop for corporate and personal gifting, free Australia-wide delivery
companies.fit_rationale: A Melbourne corporate gifting seller whose hampers carry branded chocolate and biscuits from other companies. It is tier 3 because it is a small team founded in 2020 and sells mainly to corporate buyers.
